title: Build multiscale render-supervised video-to-jewel realizer
description: Replace the cell-mean 24x40 oracle guide encoder with multiscale spatial features and cell/rank cross-attention. Train stochastic 22-D mark realization under fixed target topology with denoised-target feature loss plus differentiable sampled render, edge/chroma, and perceptual supervision. This is the next bounded gate before a pretrained prompt-generated video scaffold or free topology.
acceptance_criteria: All four group4 held-out oracle-guide renders preserve recognizable action-defining macro geometry; report PSNR, contrast, edge, saturation, temporal change, and perceptual quality against deterministic and v1 guided controls; target topology and carried jewels remain exact; target projection remains render-identical; code, companion docs, tests, GIFs, and paper/roadmap evidence are updated.
notes:
2026-08-11 LTX four-clip gate started. Selected the evaluation-prompt clip from each of Basketball, HorseRiding, PlayingGuitar, and ApplyEyeMakeup. Decoded contract is 49x160x240. Density-scaled from the validated 120k/96x160x213 UCF contract gives ~69k jewels; selected 72k max, 9k init, 9k steps, 65,536 voxels/step, spatial split, recovery every 100. First Basketball fit will calibrate runtime/VRAM/reconstruction/effective contributors on the UUID-pinned RTX 4090 before launching the other three.
2026-08-12 multiscale v2 implementation: added 24-token/cell (scales 1,2,4; 2x2x2 subgrid) RGB+spatial/temporal derivative guide with local cell/rank cross-attention, plus denoised-endpoint exact render supervision (RGB, edge, opponent chroma, patch SSIM). Projector converted out-of-place with detached hard-boundary sigma to support stable render gradients. Local focused tests and Aine 17-test suite pass. A 20-step CUDA preflight completed in 4.23s over 48 train/16 validation views at ~3.8GiB on 2070S; full matched 12k render-weight-2 run launched as jewels-realizer-v2-12000.service while the 4090 finishes the first 72k LTX fit.
First LTX evaluation-prompt fit completed: Basketball 49x160x240, 72k jewels, 9k steps, 1523.1s on 4090. Exact rerender 28.182 dB. Contribution audit: effective mean 6384/frame, range 5485-7626; >5% peak-alpha mean 7389, range 6463-8828. Visual keeps court, players, ball motion, and red uniforms but softens fine fence/tree detail and fast limbs. Gate passes as semantic-scaffold/realizer target, not final codec. Remaining HorseRiding/PlayingGuitar/ApplyEyeMakeup fits launched unchanged as jewels-ltx-fit-gate-rest.service.
Matched v2 token-only multiscale+render2 run completed 12k in 647.2s and rendered all 4 UCF group4 classes. Aggregate guided projected metrics versus v1: PSNR 16.419 vs 16.555 (-0.137), SSIM 0.8441 vs 0.8475 (-0.0033), contrast 0.8694 vs 0.8555 (+0.0138), edge 0.9108 vs 0.9050 (+0.0058), saturation 0.9194 vs 0.9371, temporal-change 1.7833 vs 1.7236. Mixed per-class/visual result does not pass. Diagnosis: token-only path removed v1's 3D conv/global guide context. Added explicit hybrid mode retaining v1 raster guide plus residual local tokens; 2.15M hybrid feature-only preflight passes and full 12k jewels-realizer-hybrid-12000.service launched. Also built validated 12-UCF-train/4-LTX-validation manifest/cache for zero-shot teacher-distribution evaluation.
Matched UCF held-out ablations completed 2026-08-12. Token-only multiscale+render2: 16.419 dB/0.8441 SSIM versus v1 16.555/0.8475; hybrid raster+tokens feature-only: 16.240/0.8345; raster render2: 16.009/0.8388. Raster render0.5 raises SSIM to 0.8557, contrast ratio to 0.9351, and edge ratio to 0.9251, but loses 0.307 dB overall and destabilizes PlayingGuitar by -1.574 dB with excess temporal change. Reject all four candidates and retain v1 raster feature-flow for LTX transfer. Horse 72k fit completed at corpus-log 31.692 dB, mean effective density 7,134/frame; Guitar remains fitting.
Final gate 2026-08-12: all four unseen LTX evaluation-prompt videos fit at 72k jewels and 49x160x240. Exact replay PSNR spans 28.182-35.158 dB (mean 31.472); mean effective contributors are 5,966/frame and mean above-5%-alpha contributors are 6,883/frame, validating the intended density regime. The frozen UCF-trained v1 realizer then transferred without retraining: guided flow reaches 15.342 dB/0.6942 SSIM versus deterministic 13.777/0.4160, improves every class in both metrics, moves contrast/edge ratios from 0.426/0.486 to 0.743/0.830, and retains 99.085% birth-cell adherence. Horse, guitar, and makeup remain recognizable; basketball is the weakest/blurry case. Correct and shuffled text are tied under the true LTX guide, so the result proves scaffold-conditioned jewel realization, not independent text semantics. Matched multiscale/render-loss candidates were rejected; retain frozen v1. Added complete reports/GIFs/contact sheets, roadmap and 19-page visually verified paper. Local suite passes 144 tests. Follow-ups: jewels-7g2 learns topology/density with overlap carry; jewels-9bd reserves foreground/motion supervision after topology is autonomous.
close_reason: Completed the bounded realizer gate: frozen UCF jewel realization transfers to four unseen prompt-generated LTX scaffolds with all-class metric gains and 3/4 recognizable actions; density, controls, artifacts, tests, roadmap, and paper are complete. Autonomous scaffold-conditioned topology is separated into jewels-7g2.

title: Implement persistent streaming jewel contract spike
description: Define physical-time jewel lifetimes and stable IDs, extract rolling prefix/future windows from one continuous fitted volume, carry boundary-crossing jewels without regeneration, audit active density/birth rate/lifespans, and prove deterministic carry/commit rendering has no seam. This precedes the multi-window prompt-conditioned continuation model.
notes: Persistent streaming contract implemented and validated. 69 tests pass. 45k isotropic: 2,933 effective/frame, median lifespan 5; 90k isotropic: 3,822 and lifespan 3; 90k spatial: 8,403 and lifespan 11. The continuous 96f/120k spatial fit completed in 2.00h at 33.254 dB full render, with 10,301 effective/frame (min 8,391), median/p95 lifespan 15/28, boundary carry 17.8k-20.0k, and carry/commit max error 1.19e-7. Use a 32-frame prefix for continuation because it covers p95 support.
close_reason: Stable-ID carry/commit contract, physical density/lifecycle metrics, real 90k controls, and one continuous 96-frame training target all pass.

title: Factor mark-flow lifecycle from appearance
description: Replace shared-trunk scalar saliency tuning with a two-stream sampling control. Integrate the frozen selected v1 mark-flow trajectory independently, copy temporal center and time-coupled covariance state from it exactly, and train a residual stream that can alter only spatial geometry/appearance under foreground, rare-chroma, and motion-boundary supervision.
acceptance_criteria: On the deterministic four-class LTX three-window gate, lifecycle dimensions and stable IDs are bit-identical to the selected base; quiet-region temporal MAE does not increase; foreground/detail or motion-boundary metrics improve in at least three classes without lowering macro PSNR/SSIM; correct/shuffled/null controls, per-class metrics, videos, checkpoint provenance, docs, tests, and paper evidence are retained. Reject the architecture if the constrained residual cannot beat the base.
notes: Completed 2026-08-12. Two-stream sampler independently integrates frozen run_12000 and candidate from shared seed; frozen stream owns topology/carry row selection/IDs and dims (2,5,7,8), with constraints reapplied after each Euler step, projection, and global transform. Unconstrained residual: 14.9713 dB/0.65629 but quiet 0.0224059 (+4.45%). Dimension screens localize regression; selected RGB-only residual in top 20% scaffold-salient cells reaches 14.6041 dB/0.63140 vs base 14.5700/0.63060, foreground PSNR 10.3591 vs 10.2252, foreground-edge 0.68486 vs 0.68952, motion-boundary 0.072268 vs 0.072349, quiet 0.0214395 vs 0.0214519. Foreground PSNR/edge/motion each improve in 3 classes, PSNR in 4. Lifecycle/counts/IDs exact across 12 controls; density exact at 7492.93/frame. Evidence: sol/results/ltx_scaffold_v1/lifecycle_appearance_ablation; 187 tests pass; 24-page PDF visually verified. Two classes have tiny quiet increases below 1e-5, documented. Follow-up compact adapter is jewels-brv.
close_reason: Passed the deterministic macro gate with scaffold-gated RGB residual; exact two-stream ownership proven and documented. Full-field residual rejected, conservative top-20% arm selected.

title: Learn scaffold-conditioned topology and density with overlap carry
description: Replace privileged fitted birth cells, positive counts, and birth ranks with predictions from the frozen prompt-video scaffold. Preserve stable-ID jewels copied from the overlap exactly, generate only frontier births, and treat effective contributors per unit space-time as a measured target rather than a raw jewel quota.
acceptance_criteria: On held-out prompt scaffolds, autonomous topology predicts occupied cells/counts/ranks without target fields; two overlapping continuation windows preserve carried IDs exactly; effective contributors remain in the 5k-10k/frame regime where content warrants it; seam, birth adherence, density drift, PSNR/SSIM, prompt selectivity, and correct-vs-shuffled/null controls are reported with rendered artifacts.
notes:
2026-08-12 resumed after frozen LTX realizer gate. First bounded milestone: audit existing cell/count/rank targets and streaming carry contracts, then implement a scaffold-conditioned topology head with oracle-marks and exact-carry controls before coupling it to stochastic mark realization.
2026-08-12 topology and coupling gate: implemented 0.88M scaffold/carry occupancy plus positive-count head, train-only threshold calibration, correct/shuffled/null/no-carry/train-mean controls, exact-carry oracle-mark rollout, and frozen-flow coupling. On all held-out LTX views correct slot F1 is 0.6636 versus 0.6092 shuffled, 0.6091 null, and 0.6222 train mean. On the shared 32-48 continuation learned topology predicts 70,724 versus 70,952 births; synthesizing every predicted rank yields 15.464 dB / 0.6967 SSIM and 5,822 effective contributors/frame versus 15.492 dB / 0.6997 oracle topology, with 0.0 carry error. Exact fitted-rank retention was rejected as a density proxy because Gaussian decompositions are non-unique. Acceptance remains partial: initial-state generation and at least two generated-mark strides with model-produced carry are open.
2026-08-12 autonomous completion: initial topology/marks plus two learned continuation strides now use only generated append-only state. Correct held-out LTX rollouts reach 14.445 dB / 0.6249 SSIM, 7,480 effective jewels/frame, 0.959 seam/regular change, exact stable IDs, and 0.0 carry error. Correct beats shuffled by 3.927 dB. Initial clip censoring was fixed without weakening strict continuation birth projection.
Superseding deterministic seed-31 audit: exact strict-vs-censored boundary control gives correct 12.408 to 14.570 dB, SSIM 0.6041 to 0.6306, correct-shuffled margin 4.116 dB, 7,493 effective jewels/frame, seam/regular 0.9636, frame-zero >5%-alpha density 8,586-9,513, and exact IDs/carry. The earlier 14.445 figure is retained as the pre-determinism run, not the authoritative metric.
close_reason: Autonomous scaffold-conditioned topology/density and two overlapping generated-state continuations meet all acceptance gates with exact carry, intended density, controls, metrics, and videos.

Add an initial-state mark realizer compatible with the observed 1,024-rank topology contract, then run at least two consecutive learned-topology/generated-mark frontier strides using only model-produced persistent state as carry.
acceptance_criteria: On held-out prompt-generated scaffolds, initial topology and marks use no fitted jewel features; two later strides predict topology and marks from the scaffold plus model-produced carry; stable IDs and carried features remain exact; seams, density, capacity, PSNR/SSIM, motion/detail, and correct-versus-shuffled/null scaffold controls are reported with videos.
notes:
2026-08-12: Claimed. Next gate is a 1,024-rank initial-compatible scaffold mark/background realizer followed by initial + two continuation strides using only generated persistent state; 2070S is the execution target and 4090 remains free.
2026-08-12 complete. Trained one 2.13M 1,024-rank mark flow for 12,000 steps across 12 initial and 60 continuation UCF views on the 2070S. Three-window held-out LTX rollouts begin from zero jewels and use only generated state thereafter. A censored initial-boundary correction raises frame-zero visible density from 106-244 to 8,586-9,513 without retraining. Four-source correct macro is 14.445 dB / 0.6249 SSIM versus 10.518 / 0.0189 shuffled and 11.521 / 0.0522 null; effective density is 7,480/frame; seam/regular change is 0.959; all IDs exact and prior/carry feature error 0.0. Videos, contacts, full metrics, and provenance are recorded under sol/results/ltx_scaffold_v1/scaffold_mark_rollout/.
Superseding deterministic seed-31 audit: selected three-window result is 14.570 dB / 0.6306 SSIM, shuffled 10.454 dB, null 11.663 dB, 7,493 effective jewels/frame, seam/regular 0.9636, frame-zero visible 8,586-9,513, and exact IDs/carry. The strict initial control is 12.408 dB / 0.6041 SSIM. This deterministic report supersedes the earlier nondeterministic metrics.
close_reason: Acceptance met: autonomous initial plus two generated-state continuations, exact persistent state, density/seam/capacity/render/control reports, and rendered artifacts are complete.

title: Train prefix-to-future jewel continuation overfit
description: Using the 96-frame joint fitted field, encode rolling 16-frame-prefix/16-frame-future views and train a small masked conditional prior to preserve carried IDs while predicting future birth counts and jewel marks. Gate against independent-window generation on seam error, future render quality, density drift, and birth/lifespan statistics.
notes: Passed learned continuation overfit. Four 32-prefix/16-future views from the joint 96f/120k field use stable-ID carry plus learned births. Selected 0.80M cell-local model: correct feature MSE 0.4475 vs 1.1988 disjoint-shuffled and 2.1695 null; count MAE 0.3310; birth ratio 0.9995; sampled field PSNR 19.870 dB; carried max error 0.0. Cell-local context improves 3.41 dB over matched global pooling. 81 sol tests pass. Artifacts: sol/results/streaming_continuation_local/. Limits: single-clip oracle-rank overfit; held-out rollout/text remain open.

title: Develop foreground- and motion-aware jewel realization supervision
description: Retain the frozen v1 raster-guided realizer as the baseline and redesign sampling/losses only if autonomous topology is no longer dominant. Weight moving foreground, thin structures, rare chroma, faces/hands, and motion boundaries while explicitly constraining temporal flicker and background stability.
acceptance_criteria: A matched four-class ablation improves recognizable moving-subject detail and motion-boundary error over v1 without reducing macro PSNR/SSIM or increasing excess temporal change; report per-class render, edge, saturation, temporal, and foreground metrics; reject the branch if gains are not consistent across at least three classes.
notes:
2026-08-12 unblocked by learned-topology gate. Learned topology is within 0.028 dB / 0.0030 SSIM of oracle topology at intended density, and visual inspection shows the same moving-subject noise in both. This localizes the next fidelity bottleneck in mark realization. Preserve v1 and require matched correct/oracle-topology panels while testing foreground, motion-boundary, rare-chroma, face/hand, and temporal-stability supervision.
2026-08-12 claimed after autonomous topology gate closed. First bounded ablation will initialize from the frozen 12k universal mark flow, retain the selected initial-boundary policy, mix uniform and scaffold-derived foreground/motion/chroma patches, and add explicit low-motion stability supervision. Evaluate the identical four LTX sources/seed against the selected base; reject unless macro PSNR/SSIM and motion stability hold with at least three class-level detail gains.
2026-08-12 bounded scalar-supervision result: implemented label-free scaffold saliency sampling, rendered foreground/motion/quiet-stability losses, per-jewel saliency-weighted feature flow, lifecycle-safe dimension selection, deterministic rollout provenance, and target-derived foreground/motion/quiet metrics. Four 1k initialized arms were evaluated. The decisive exact PyTorch 2.12 CUDA/20-step/seed31 spatial-appearance+stability arm improves the base from 14.570 to 14.972 dB and 0.6306 to 0.6610 SSIM, improves PSNR/SSIM in all four classes, foreground-edge and motion-boundary error in three, and macro temporal-change ratio by 0.0046. It nevertheless raises quiet temporal MAE from 0.02145 to 0.02227 (+3.8%), with Guitar and Makeup about +0.0018 each, and foreground PSNR worsens in Basketball and Guitar. Reject under the predeclared consistency/stability gate; retain v1. Next: freeze an independently integrated v1 lifecycle trajectory and train an appearance/geometry residual stream that cannot modify temporal center/time covariance. Require bit-exact lifecycle and no quiet-temporal regression.
close_reason: Implemented and evaluated four foreground/motion/quiet-stability supervision arms. The exact-seed combined arm improves global fidelity but violates the quiet-temporal and three-class foreground consistency gates, so it is rejected and v1 remains selected. Follow-up lifecycle/appearance factorization is tracked as jewels-4pt.

title: Train compact scaffold-gated appearance adapter
description: Replace the second full BirthMarkFlowModel used by the passing two-stream control with a zero-initialized residual adapter over the frozen v1 mark flow. Begin with RGB in scaffold-salient cells, then expand spatial color gradients or geometry only under exact base-owned topology/lifecycle/ID constraints. Train on the leakage-safe UCF corpus and retain correct/shuffled/null controls.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen base sampling is bit-identical to run_12000 for the same deterministic seed; adapter is materially smaller than a second 2.13M flow copy; deterministic four-class three-window PSNR, SSIM, foreground PSNR/edge, motion-boundary, and macro quiet MAE are no worse than the selected top-20% RGB control; foreground/detail improves in at least three classes; no class raises quiet MAE by more than 1e-5; topology, density, lifecycle dimensions, stable IDs, videos, provenance, docs, tests, and paper evidence are retained. Reject expanded residual dimensions that fail.

title: Condition persistent jewel generation on UCF text prompts
description: After learned continuation passes, condition initial generation and future birth/update sampling on UCF class prompt templates. Require correct prompts to beat shuffled and null controls while preserving rollout density, identity, motion, and color.
notes:

A fresh 3000-step run with identical split, 32^3x24 rank tokenizer, and 75% source-saliency render sampling is active on PyTorch cuda:1 / physical RTX 2070 SUPER at /home/m/jewels/tokenizer/prompt_shared_3000 (log /home/m/jewels/logs/prompt_shared_3000.log). Both are visually nearly identical and worse than learned-position overfit 23.6574, proving the learned tables memorized single-video content and channel width was not the solution. Global count loss: 23.6555 dB / 87.705%; balanced weight0.25: 23.8141 / 93.149%; selected balanced weight0.5: 24.5861 / 97.694%, beating learned overfit by 0.929 dB and 32^3x64 by 2.85 dB. Dense 64^3 is a proxy; if it passes, implement sparse occupied fine tokens under the coarse hierarchy.
Completed exposure-matched shared 64^3x8 tokenizer: fixed group4 audit 20.7353 dB / 99.794% count; seen shard0 22.4129 / 98.405%. Both visually erase actors, so tokenizer gate fails. Implemented compact occupied-group codec/checkpoint dispatch. Horse controls: 4x32 weak-render 24.7516/100%; 2x24 24.3166/100%; 4x32 render-weight2 26.0193/100%; 1x16 upper bound 26.0869/100%. Visuals remain noisy, proving learned jewel reconstruction is the wrong critical path. Implemented direct prompt-conditioned birth trainer with text/context dropout and held-out correct/shuffled/null evaluation plus free-count renders. 3000-step 0.84M run: text-only mark MSE correct 1.1579 vs shuffled 1.1794 vs null 1.1641; counts change deterministically by action prompt and correct field PSNR beats shuffled for all four group4 classes, but videos remain washed out. 12000-step context50 strengthens correct-vs-shuffled mark margin to 3.69% while topology/null control fails. Occupied/empty-balanced scalar count regression worsens false positives. Next: factor topology into calibrated occupancy classification plus positive-count regression, retain direct 22-D jewel marks, then rerun free correct/shuffled/null render gate before initial-window generation.
Washed-out fix was re-evaluated before implementing the proposed occupancy/count split. Exact target cells/counts/ranks improve the deterministic held-out render only 14.0597 to 14.2319 dB (+0.1722); predicted geometry alone is 14.4338 dB, predicted color/gradient alone 15.2551, predicted opacity alone 24.8157. Only 39.73% of predicted centers remain in their supplied spatial cell and 25.41% in the full birth cell, so topology adherence is defective but not causal for washout. A 12k-step 1.54M oracle-topology stochastic mark flow restores raw edge energy to 84.44% and PSNR 15.0642 but yields incoherent speckle. A 12k-step 2.13M oracle-video-guide control using the true future at 24x40 reaches 16.5554 dB, 85.55% contrast, and 90.50% edge energy, +2.3236 dB over deterministic marks, with visibly restored macro-layout on all four group4 sources. Corrected hard projection preserves fitted targets at 100 dB. Decision: do not build the count head next. Build a multiscale, cross-attentive, render/perceptual-supervised video-to-jewel realizer under privileged guide/topology; then replace the oracle guide with a frozen pretrained text-to-video scaffold and only afterward learn scaffold-conditioned occupancy/counts. Full suite: 120 tests + 1 subtest pass. Paper and GIF evidence updated.
2026-08-12 scaffold-transfer milestone: 16 LTX prompt videos are complete; four held-out evaluation-prompt videos were reconstructed at 72k jewels with 31.472 dB mean replay PSNR and 5,966 effective contributors/frame. The frozen UCF v1 guided realizer transfers without retraining at 15.342 dB/0.6942 SSIM versus deterministic 13.777/0.4160 and improves every class; 3/4 actions remain recognizable. Correct/shuffled text ties under the privileged true-future LTX guide, so prompt semantics still live in the raster scaffold. Next active gate is jewels-7g2: learn scaffold-conditioned cells/counts/ranks and prove overlap carry before direct text-to-jewel distillation.
